steps.label: viewport
steps.expr: (() => ({ innerHeight: window.innerHeight, docHeight: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, screens: +(document.documentElement.scrollHeight / window.innerHeight).toFixed(2) }))()

steps.label: block-height-map
steps.expr: (() => { const out = []; const root = document.querySelector('main') || document.body; const walk = (el, depth) => { if (depth > 4) return; for (const c of el.children) { const h = c.offsetHeight; if (h < 24) continue; const txt = (c.innerText || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 64); out.push({ d: depth, h, tag: c.tagName, id: c.id || null, cls: (c.className || '').toString().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 58), txt }); walk(c, depth + 1); } }; walk(root, 0); return out; })()

steps.label: vertical-gaps
steps.expr: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('form') || document.querySelector('main'); if (!card) return null; const kids = Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('div,section,p,h1,h2,h3,button,input,span')).filter(e => e.offsetHeight > 0); let biggest = []; for (const k of kids) { const cs = getComputedStyle(k); const mg = parseFloat(cs.marginTop) + parseFloat(cs.marginBottom); const pd = parseFloat(cs.paddingTop) + parseFloat(cs.paddingBottom); if (mg + pd >= 30) biggest.push({ tag: k.tagName, cls: (k.className||'').toString().replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,44), mt: cs.marginTop, mb: cs.marginBottom, pt: cs.paddingTop, pb: cs.paddingBottom, total: Math.round(mg+pd), txt: (k.innerText||'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,34) }); } biggest.sort((a,b) => b.total - a.total); return biggest.slice(0, 18); })()

steps.label: field-inventory
steps.expr: (() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input,textarea,select')).map(i => ({ id: i.id || null, name: i.name || null, type: i.type || i.tagName, label: (document.querySelector('label[for="' + i.id + '"]') || {}).textContent || null, h: i.offsetHeight })))()

steps.label: static-copy-blocks
steps.expr: (() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('p,h1,h2,h3,span,div')).filter(e => e.children.length === 0 && (e.innerText||'').trim().length > 25 && e.offsetHeight > 0).map(e => ({ h: e.offsetHeight, tag: e.tagName, txt: (e.innerText||'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,90) })).sort((a,b) => b.h - a.h).slice(0, 16))()
